mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% over the past three months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Sustained decline in FEDFUNDS not maintained over the past three months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market, reducing wage growth expectations and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and sustained growth in GDPC1 (demand) creates a contractionary policy with robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 > previous month's value
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not rise above 4.5% or GDPC1 growth does not accompany FEDFUNDS increases, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rapid growth in INDPRO (supply) without corresponding demand growth signals overcapacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not exceed 2% or GDPC1 growth is not below 1%, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand) above 1500 units signals unexpected economic activity, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 1500 or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers short-term selling pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not cross above 4.5% or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of rising PAYEMS (payrolls) above 160,000 and falling UNRATE below 4.0% signals robust labor demand and tight supply, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS do not exceed 160,000 or UNRATE does not fall below 4.0%, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) alongside rising FEDFUNDS rates creates a contractionary environment with strong supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 105 or FEDFUNDS do not rise above 4.0%, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
